intro.text: A squadleader in Brightlord Amaram's army.

items.text: In one of Amaram's battles, Kaladin reinforced Mesh's battered squad while searching for Tien. The enemy was closing from the south and east, but Mesh and the neighbouring squadleader Varth were told to hold only against the east. When Kaladin spotted Tien in Varth's squad, he left Mesh's line just as the enemy reached them.
